title: The commuting square grows a ternary spatial address
kind: Exact semantic lift with finite-map and intrinsic local censuses
summary: The two paths around a commuting square and their XOR residual define a rule-independent recursive L/R/C lift. Depth-d words form a 3^d ternary address space with a forced algebraic quotient; finite-map and infinite-lattice local censuses show broad but rule-dependent role growth rather than a Class-IV-exclusive signature.
takeaway: The commutator can be represented as a new coordinate rather than only measured: each added semantic dimension stores the two operation orders and their residual. The next target is a native autonomous higher-dimensional CA realization, likely organized around the correction map rather than full ternary-vocabulary closure.
